name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: Displays a form textarea or a component that looks like a textarea.

examples.title: Default
examples.source:
import Textarea from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/textarea/textarea.marko";

<Textarea placeholder="Type your message here." />
examples.description: A plain textarea with a placeholder.

examples.title: With label
examples.description: Pair a textarea with a `Label` via a shared id.

examples.title: With text
examples.source: import Textarea from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/textarea/textarea.marko"; import Label from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/label/label.marko";
examples.description: Add helper text below the textarea to explain its purpose.

examples.title: With value
examples.source:
import Textarea from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/textarea/textarea.marko";

<Textarea aria-label="Feedback" value="This is some existing feedback that a user has already typed into the textarea. It demonstrates how the field grows with field-sizing-content as content wraps across multiple lines." />
examples.description: Uncontrolled initial content. `field-sizing-content` grows the textarea with its content as the user types.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.source:
import Textarea from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/textarea/textarea.marko";

<Textarea disabled placeholder="Type your message here." />
examples.description: A disabled textarea is skipped by the tab order and ignores pointer input.

examples.title: Invalid
examples.source:
import Textarea from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/textarea/textarea.marko";

<Textarea aria-invalid="true" placeholder="Type your message here." />
examples.description: Set `aria-invalid` to mark the textarea as invalid.

examples.title: Button
examples.description: Pair a textarea with a `Button` to create a message composer.

examples.title: RTL
examples.description: Textareas restyle correctly under `dir="rtl"` — logical Tailwind properties, not physical ones, drive layout and text alignment.
